=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2091-2118 (grant 2156-2159; multi-holder 2360-2383); scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3291-3297 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` returns 0 (eligible) when a waiter's login lookup, statuses read, or jq parse fails, so a soft-skip candidate (`tick_first_soft=1`) takes the `break` path, gets the lease, and `_merge_lease_write` drops its skip entry without a trusted head-gate success.
  WHY: This breaks the G5 rule that "A failed head-gate read keeps the skip entry"; four reviewers rated it MAJOR, but z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT because grant-time eligibility has always failed open; the highest rating is used.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3313-3333 (callers scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1976-2033; dispatch 1484-1507) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The G1 grace branch of `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` checks only runs whose head_sha is the PR head (`_pr_head_ci_runs_pending`), but `_mt_dispatch_review` runs the review on the default branch, so a holder whose only live run is a queued or running dispatch review is still revoked with `revoked_no_head_gate`.
  WHY: The tick revokes on ineligibility before the idle (G2) branch, the only place that matches `[pr:<n>]` dispatches, is ever reached, so the #9628/#9702/#9239 incident still happens; the tests pass only because the fake models the review as a `pull_request` run on the head.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1407-1471, 1719-1763 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_mt_lease_pr_runs_active` calls `_mt_inflight_review_branches >/dev/null || true` and marks the cache `ok` whenever `MT_INFLIGHT_RUNS_ALL_JSON` is a non-empty array, so it ignores the return code (1) that reports an incomplete listing (`unattributed_run`/`filter_failed`).
  WHY: On an incomplete listing the helper reports no active run, and the tick revokes the holder with `revoked_idle` (2002-2006 / 2279-2283), which breaks the rule that "a failed or incomplete run read keeps the holder".
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1723, 1864-1866, 2656-2665, 2747 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_mt_release` runs `_mt_inflight_review_branches` inside a command substitution (line 2659), so `MT_INFLIGHT_RUNS_ALL_JSON` and `MT_DEFAULT_BRANCH` are lost; `_mt_merge_lease_tick` then resets `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_STATE`/`_MT_LEASE_RUNS_JSON` and runs a second full listing pass in the same invocation.
  WHY: This breaks the G2 budget ("at most one listing pass per tick") and the §14 cycle-local cache rule, costing about 10 extra `actions/runs?status=` reads plus a `GET repos/<repo>`; the tests miss it because `_p2_tick` calls the tick directly.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3315-3321 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The prefix assignment `AUTO_MERGE_WAIT_WORKFLOWS="${elig_run_names}" ... _pr_head_ci_runs_pending "${elig_head}"` on a shell function call is said to persist in the calling shell, which would leak the review workflow names into later `_pr_head_ci_runs_pending` calls.
  WHY: Later calls (`_pr_wait_for_required_checks` at 1157) could count review runs as pending CI and bind a review run id as the required CI (`ci_bind` at 1159), which is the #6963 cross-workflow false success; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this claim (bash restores the prefix assignment because no script in `scripts/` turns on POSIX mode).
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3862-3904 (multi 3694-3738) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: In `_merge_lease_gate`/`_merge_lease_gate_multi`, a caller with an uncleared soft skip entry that is the only waiter gets an empty `lease_first` from `_merge_lease_queue_first`, falls through to `_merge_lease_write`, takes the lease, and overwrites its skip entry.
  WHY: The PR can take the lease while its head-gate is pending or unreadable, which is contrary to G5; `test_gate_keeps_a_soft_entry_without_a_trusted_success` covers only the case with another waiter; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this claim as the existing, documented lone-caller rule.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2636-2644 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_wedged_queued_seconds` reads `${ZOMBIE_RUN_MAX_QUEUED_HOURS:-24}`, but the lease tick entry points (orchestrate_poll.yml, cancel_on_pr_close.yml) do not export the repository variable; only .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:244 does.
  WHY: The lease always uses 24 hours, which drifts from the reaper and from the README/agents-fragment claim that it follows the shared #9473 rule.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1863, 2033, 2229, 2298 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The writers of three-field `pr:head:reason` entries are guarded only by `declare -F _merge_lease_skips_hard` in the staged library, so an update-mode gate running an older pr_checks_lib copy (pre-#9983 normalize regex `^[1-9][0-9]*:[0-9a-f]{40}$`) can drop those entries.
  WHY: During rollout, hard entries (`revoked_idle`, `expired`, `revoked_final_ci_failed`) can be erased and a revoked PR granted again on the same head; the window is transient and fails open.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2590-2712 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Older library copies of `_merge_lease_skips_normalize` do not recognise the three-field `pr:head:reason` format and drop those entries.
  WHY: Hard entries such as `revoked_idle` or `expired` can be erased, so a revoked PR can be granted again on the same head; this is transient but breaks the G6/G5 logic.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3393-3427 (callers 3867, 3696) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Every update-mode gate call runs `_merge_lease_skips_effective`, which does up to 10 status reads plus `GET user` for every labelled waiter with a soft entry, including waiters that sort behind the caller.
  WHY: Those reads do not affect `_merge_lease_queue_first`, so they waste API calls (up to 7 extra per gate call).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "G2: reuse the active-run listing the merge train already has (the actions/runs?status=<s> reads documented near scripts/review_merge_train.sh:1187). At most one listing pass per tick, cached for all holders."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_merge_train.sh, the release loop at line 2659 (`_mt_release` listing inside $(...)) and the cache reset at the start of _mt_merge_lease_tick (lines 1864-1866)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: no hunk passes the release pass's listing result to _mt_lease_pr_runs_active or seeds _MT_LEASE_RUNS_JSON from it, the release subshell at 2656-2659 discards MT_INFLIGHT_RUNS_ALL_JSON, the tick unconditionally sets _MT_LEASE_RUNS_STATE="", the tick's first _mt_lease_pr_runs_active call lists again from scratch, the cache only prevents repeats inside the tick
- requirement: "`tests/test_merge_lease.py` and `tests/test_review_merge_train.py`, with the existing fake `gh`" (issue #9983 Tests section; the plan's files_touched also lists tests/test_review_merge_train.py)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_merge_train.py
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: tests/test_review_merge_train.py has no hunk and is absent from pr_changed_files.txt, all new coverage (HolderRunsActive, SoftSkipEntries, RunsHelpers, fake-gh active_runs) is only in tests/test_merge_lease.py and tests/merge_lease_fake_gh.py, the harness calls _mt_merge_lease_tick directly, so the _mt_release listing-to-tick integration and the _mt_merge_lease_tick/_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi merge-train paths are untested, mitigating: the file is an inherited pre-push failure on the merge-base
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- (Dropped claims) The `AUTO_MERGE_WAIT_WORKFLOWS=... _pr_head_ci_runs_pending` prefix assignment does not leak, because no script in `scripts/` turns on POSIX mode. The lone waiter with a soft entry acquiring in the update-mode gate is the existing lone-caller rule and is documented in the code comment.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_tick candidate loop, lines 2096-2105; scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh _merge_lease_pr_eligible lines 3291 and 3294-3297; multi-holder loop lines 2363-2370 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: For a soft-skip waiter, `_merge_lease_pr_eligible` returns 0 when the statuses read fails, the reply cannot be parsed, or `tick_login` is empty or invalid, so the loop breaks and the lease is granted at line 2159, dropping the skip entry.
  WHY: A transient read failure grants the lease to a PR whose head-gate is still pending, which breaks "A failed head-gate read keeps the skip entry"; this path is new. Fix: when `tick_first_soft=1`/`tm_first_soft=1`, require a confirmed `success <login>` state.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_lease_pr_runs_active lines 1719-1728; _mt_inflight_review_branches line 1409, lines 1460-1461, return 1 at 1471 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The lease helper ignores the return code that marks the listing incomplete (`unattributed_run`) and treats the raw array as complete, returning 1 ("none").
  WHY: A holder whose only live review is an unattributed dispatch (e.g. a review_autofix.yml self re-dispatch) is revoked with `revoked_idle` (2002-2006; multi 2279-2283). Fix: when the return code is non-zero with reason `unattributed_run`, set `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_STATE=failed` (return 2).
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_pr_eligible lines 3313-3333; caller scripts/review_merge_train.sh lines 1976-1978 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The G1 read checks only runs whose head_sha is the PR head, but `_mt_dispatch_review` (1484-1507) runs on the default branch; the `[pr:<n>]` check is wired only into the idle (G2) branch, which runs after eligibility has passed.
  WHY: A holder with a pending head-gate and a queued dispatch review is still released with `revoked_no_head_gate`, which contradicts the README. Fix: when `MERGE_LEASE_HEAD_RUNS_READ=true` and the reason is `no_head_gate`, consult `_mt_lease_pr_runs_active` before revoking (in both holder branches).
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:writers at lines 2033 and 2298, guarded by `declare -F _merge_lease_skips_hard` at lines 1863 and 2229 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: An update-mode gate running an older pr_checks_lib copy (normalize regex `^[1-9][0-9]*:[0-9a-f]{40}$`) drops every `pr:head:reason` line.
  WHY: During rollout, hard entries can be erased and a revoked PR granted again on the same head; the window is transient and fails open.
